title: rust
responsibility: Audits Rust sources for size limits and documented unsafe code.

outputs.name: rustAdapter
outputs.description: The Rust AuditAdapter object (id 'rust', label 'Rust', profiles 'dapp' and 'lib', extension '.rs', optional tools 'cargo fmt' and 'cargo clippy') whose audit(file) method returns the file-length, curly-function and unsafe findings for one file. It is declared for .rs files in the 'dapp' and 'lib' profiles, but audit(file) does not check the extension, looks for '// SAFETY:' within the 3 lines above an unsafe block and '# Safety' within the 8 lines above an unsafe fn, and ignores text inside string and character literals and line comments when counting braces and detecting functions and unsafe code.
